name: arabic-helpers
title: Arabic Helpers
description: Convert Arabic numerals and remove or add Arabic harakat
author: goodm4ven

commands.name: convert-arabic-numerals
commands.title: Convert Arabic Numerals
commands.description: Convert text between Western and Arabic-Indic numerals

commands.name: arabic-harakat
commands.title: Arabic Harakat
commands.description: Remove Arabic harakat or optionally add them with Raycast AI

preferences.name: enableAIHarakat
preferences.title: AI Harakat
preferences.label: Enable Add Harakat with AI
preferences.description: Shows an explicit action that sends the plain Arabic text to Raycast AI. Requires Raycast AI access.

preferences.name: preloadTextAutomatically
preferences.title: Automatic Text Loading
preferences.label: Preload selected text or clipboard
preferences.description: When enabled, preloads selected text and falls back to the clipboard. When disabled, commands always start empty.

scripts.check: npm run test && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

To publish this extension to the Raycast Store, use \`npm run publish\`.

" && exit 1
